contract_scope: Functional slot-memory prototype and numerical mathematical checks; no model integration, optimization, benchmark, learned controller, or SOTA evidence.

checks.name: commit_updates_one_slot_and_metadata_atomically
checks.scope: Invalid slot values are treated as zero despite nonzero backing storage. Commits increment slot version; expired slots retain validity until overwritten.

checks.name: convex_slot_bound_over_4096_steps
checks.scope: Bounded state under arbitrary sampled proposals; no claim about training gradients.

checks.name: all_protected_rejects_commit_but_workspace_progresses
checks.scope: Current branch proposal remains usable; this does not prove a full network avoids stalls.

checks.name: frozen_controls_and_proposal_have_diagonal_nonexpansive_transport
checks.scope: Partial derivative through memory carry only; controls and proposal fixed.

checks.name: bounded_state_does_not_imply_stable_full_jacobian
checks.scope: Counterexample: controller/branch derivatives must be studied separately.

checks.name: protected_view_nullspace_write_can_be_nonnormal_and_amplifying
checks.scope: Read invariance alone gives no Euclidean norm bound; motivates coordinate slots plus bounded convex writes.

checks.name: reference_step_is_causal_under_identical_input_prefix
checks.scope: Reference step and supplied current-only controls; not a learned-controller causality audit.

checks.name: external_lease_trace_capacity_tracks_concurrent_live_versions
checks.lifetime_rule: write at t, expiry t+1+(t mod 4), half-open lifetime
checks.scope: Exact retention for externally supplied leases and distinct versions in this trace. No learned lease, semantic compression, task gain, or general performance claim.

checks.name: minimum_predicted_risk_regret_is_at_most_twice_error_bound
checks.scope: Elementary selection bound conditional on known uniform error; no estimator calibration or learned eviction evidence.
